seoTitle: Douglas County School District Calendar 2027-2028 | Holidays & PDF
seoDescription: View the DCSD 2027-2028 school calendar with the August 11 first day, May 25 last day, 173 student days, breaks, PLC delayed starts, and official PDF.
heroSummary: Douglas County School District begins the 2027-28 conventional school year on Wednesday, August 11, 2027, and the last student day is Thursday, May 25, 2028. The calendar lists 173 student days, Fall Break on October 11-15, Winter Break on December 20-31, and Spring Break on March 20-24. Selected Fridays are marked with a PLC delayed-start symbol, while teacher work, professional development, compensation, and district holiday dates have separate markers.
calendarNotes: The 2027-28 DCSD school calendar lists 173 student days. The first student day is August 11, 2027, and the second semester begins January 4, 2028 after a January 3 teacher work day. Fall Break runs October 11-15. Thanksgiving closure spans November 22-26, with November 24 marked as a compensation day and November 25-26 marked as district holidays. Winter Break runs December 20-31. Spring Break runs March 20-24, followed by a compensation day on April 24 and a teacher work day on May 26 after the last student day.

customSections.content: DCSD keeps the 173-day conventional schedule but gives operational dates their own markers. The diagonal blue PLC symbol signals a delayed start, while the other colors distinguish student closures from staff-only work and professional learning.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Douglas County School District start in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The first student day of the DCSD 2027-28 conventional calendar is Wednesday, August 11, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is DCSD Winter Break in 2027-28?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 20 through December 31, 2027. Students return after the January 3 teacher work day, with the second semester beginning January 4.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of DCSD school in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day is Thursday, May 25, 2028. May 26 is marked as a teacher work day.

calendarFaqs.q: What does the diagonal blue mark mean on the DCSD calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: It identifies a PLC Day (Delayed Start). Confirm the actual start time with the school because the district PDF does not give one universal bell time.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student days are in the DCSD 2027-28 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The official DCSD calendar identifies 173 all-day student sessions.
